invented.quote: Sales tax filing. Filed for you, on time.
invented.why: The brief states that the bookkeeper does sales tax filing, but does not state that it is always filed on time.

invented.quote: There's one flat price and no add-on fees.
invented.why: The brief gives the monthly charge of $199, but does not state whether or not there are any add-on fees.

invented.quote: including clients who've been with me for years.
invented.why: The brief mentions having 'existing clients' and referencing 'last year', but does not state that any clients have been with the bookkeeper for multiple years.

invented.quote: Those are my days off, and many salons are closed then too.
invented.why: The brief only states that the bookkeeper does not answer the phone on Sundays or Mondays, not that those are full days off from work.
